(in Vedānta phil.) a term for the three sheaths or succession of cases which make up the various frames of the body enveloping the soul (these are, 1. the आनन्द-मय क्˚ or ‘sheath of pleasure’, forming the कारण-शरीर or ‘causal frame’; 2. the विज्ञान-मय or बुद्धि-म्˚ or मनो-म्˚ or प्राण-म्˚ क्˚, ‘the sheath of intellect or will or life’, forming the सूक्ष्म-शरीर or ‘subtile frame’; 3. the अन्न-म्˚ क्˚, ‘the sheath of nourishment’, forming the स्थूल-शरीर or ‘gross frame’), Vedāntas.
